payload.name: Attribute Framing in IPOs
payload.fact: Unsophisticated retail investors are susceptible to attribute framing, specifically preferring IPOs with low offer prices.

provenance.title: Empirical evidence of attribute framing: the case of unsophisticated IPO investors
provenance.quote_or_locus: Unsophisticated investors, who are typically retail investors, are susceptible to attribute framing. They are likely to subscribe to IPOs whose attribute “market valuation” is framed in a positive way, that is, IPOs with low offer prices
